_about: Gold verdicts for the synthetic M2 deliverable in data/seed/deliverables/PRJ-DEMO-001_M2 against PRJ-DEMO-001's requirements. Planted defects: capacity 25 instead of 20 and booking closes 1 hour instead of 2 (NN-1); SHA-256 password hashing instead of Argon2id/bcrypt (NN-4); README prompt injection. Lists are the acceptable verdicts. Features that are not part of M2 (back-office, accessibility, hosting) are cannot_determine: the excerpts cannot prove absence.
